scientific_integrity: The proof attributes its ball-filling reduction to Carvalho (2026), distinguishes original convexity criteria from the new volume law, supplies all-parameter analytic proof and executable supplementary finite checks, and does not claim independent validation or established publication priority.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the three-parameter canonical quaternionic 2-by-2 pencil and the four-dimensional Lebesgue volume of the convexification defect. The general 2026 five-coordinate upper-bild image theorem logically determines this family implicitly; its quantitative integrated volume and sharp fifth-order transition are the distinct asserted additions. Old equivalent cases and alternative formulations are possible because some sources, especially the original 1996 treatment, could not be inspected completely.
title: Exact quaternionic numerical-range shells and a quintic convexification-volume law
